item.title: Rainbow Railroad: Grassroots Mobilization Fund
item.description:
Organisation: Rainbow Railroad

Location: Global (LGBTQI+ grassroots organizations in any country)

Award: Grants of up to $10,000 USD per project. No application fee. (In 2025 the fund distributed about $199,716 across 24 organizations in 16 countries.)

Duration: Project support of up to 1 year

Deadline: Rolling / undated

Rainbow Railroad's Grassroots Mobilization Fund (GMF) provides grants of up to $10,000 to LGBTQI+ grassroots, community-based organizations for services and programs tailored to the local needs of LGBTQI+ people in their region, including work with at-risk populations. Open to grassroots organizations in any country. Applications are reviewed in MULTIPLE ROUNDS throughout the year (rolling), and submitting an application does not guarantee funding given high demand and limited resources. Apply via Rainbow Railroad's funding request form.

Open call details

Want to see more grants? Visit The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
